### [`blog-image-sidecar.ts`](../../lib/admin/blog-image-sidecar.ts)

- `textFromDrafts` _function_: `![alt | caption | …](path)` for one image, across every filled locale.
- `sidecarForUpload` _function_: The sidecar file for an image uploaded from the blog editor, written through the same normalizer as the generator so it is byte-identical to a hand-authored one.
- Types: `LocaleDraft`

### [`blog-paths.ts`](../../lib/admin/blog-paths.ts)

- `isBlogKey` _function_: Whether the editor may offer `key` as a new author key or category slug: lowercase, and the shape the save route checks with `BLOG_SLUG_RE`, so a key the form accepts is never one the server then refuses (a trailing dash was).
- `BLOG_SLUG_RE` _const_: A post slug, translation key or author key that is safe to put into a `content/blog` path.
- `BLOG_LOCALE_RE` _const_: A locale folder under `content/blog`, such as `de` or `pt-br`.

### [`cookie.ts`](../../lib/admin/cookie.ts)

- `readCookie` _function_: Reads one cookie out of a `Cookie` header. Kept free of `next/headers` so the code that parses attacker-controlled input can be tested; split rather than matched, so the name comparison is exact and no regex runs over hostile input.

### [`github.ts`](../../lib/admin/github.ts)

- `adminRepo` _function_: The repository and base branch every admin write targets, blog posts and media alike.
- `adminGithubToken` _function_: The token the admin writes to GitHub with, or null when none is configured.
- `forkFromBase` _function_: Creates `branch` at the head of the base branch, so a write never lands on it directly. Resolves to null, or to the sentence a route reports when GitHub refused.
- `MISSING_TOKEN_HINT` _const_: What the blog editor's write routes answer when no token is configured.
- Types: `RepoRef`

### [`live-traffic.ts`](../../lib/admin/live-traffic.ts)

- `minuteSeries` _function_: The chart's minutes, oldest first: exactly `LIVE_MINUTES`, ending at the newest minute of the answer or the minute of `at`, whichever is later.
- `formatLiveClock` _function_: The time of an answer on the admin's own clock, `14:05:30`; the raw value when it is no time.
- `formatLiveMinute` _function_: A minute of the chart on the admin's own clock, `14:05`.
- `minuteTotal` _function_: The sum of one figure over the chart's minutes.
- `isQuiet` _function_: Whether nothing at all arrived in the last half hour: no minute counted anything.
- `risenKeys` _function_: The keys whose count rose since the previous answer, biggest rise first (a new key rises by its whole count).
- `pickRipples` _function_: The countries that ripple after an answer, from those that rose (biggest rise first): only those the map can place, none within `spacing` of one already picked, at most `max`.
- `placeLiveRows` _function_: Lays out a list's rows after a new answer: the rows that were shown last time and are gone now first, flagged as leaving and holding the item they were drawn with, then the rows of the answer in its order.
- `liveDrillHref` _function_: The Traffic page for today, filtered to one value seen live: where a row of the live view leads for the rest of the day's story. `dim` `null` opens today without a filter.
- `liveEventHref` _function_: The detail page of an event for today.
- `LIVE_POLL_MS` _const_: Milliseconds between two asks while the tab is in front.
- `LIVE_MINUTES` _const_: The minutes the chart shows: the last 30 whole ones and the current one.
- `MAX_RIPPLES` _const_: At most this many countries ripple after one answer, the biggest rises first.
- `RIPPLE_SPACING` _const_: How far apart two ripples of one answer start, in the units of `public/world.svg` (2000 wide): about the width of Germany, so a busy Europe sends one ring instead of five stacked ones.
- Types: `LiveMinutePoint`, `PlacedRow`

### [`mcp.ts`](../../lib/admin/mcp.ts)

- `claudeCodeAddCommandWithToken` _function_: The same command with a personal token, for a machine where no browser can finish the sign-in.
- `apiTokenKey` _function_: The cache key prefix of the token list, per account (`self` for the signed-in one).
- `apiTokensPath` _function_: The token list's path; `userId` asks for another account's, which only an owner may.
- `consentRequestPath` _function_: The OAuth request in the address bar as a proxy path, or null when it holds nothing the proxy would carry (empty or longer than any id the API issues).
- `describeScopes` _function_: Splits a space-separated OAuth `scope` into the ones the page can describe and the ones it cannot. An unknown scope is shown raw instead of dropped, so a scope the API adds before this page learns it is never approved unseen.
- `displayClientName` _function_: The app name as the consent page prints it: control characters, zero-width characters and bidirectional overrides removed (a name that reorders the text around it can pass for another), whitespace collapsed, cut at 60 characters.
- `describeRedirectHost` _function_: What a redirect host tells the person reading it: whether it is the computer they are sitting at (Claude Code listens on a loopback port) and whether a label is written in Punycode (`xn--`), the form in which look-alike domains are …
- `safeRedirectTarget` _function_: The address the browser may be sent to after a decision, or null.
- `hasPassed` _function_: Whether an ISO time has passed at `nowMs`; a missing time never expires.
- `MCP_URL` _const_: The address an MCP client connects to.
- `MCP_SERVER_NAME` _const_: The name Claude Code registers the server under, so `/mcp` lists it by a name that says whose it is.
- `CLAUDE_CODE_ADD_COMMAND` _const_: The one line that adds the server to Claude Code; the sign-in runs through `/mcp` afterwards.
- `TOKEN_EXPIRY_OPTIONS` _const_: The lifetimes the create dialog offers; `null` is a token that never expires.
- Types: `OAuthConsentRequest`, `OAuthDecision`, `AdminApiToken`, `CreatedAdminApiToken`

### [`media-references.ts`](../../lib/admin/media-references.ts)

- `postFilePath` _function_: `de/phantasialand-tipps` → `content/blog/de/phantasialand-tipps.md`.
- `postsReferencing` _function_: The post keys (`<locale>/<slug>`) whose body references the image.
- `rewriteReferences` _function_: Rewrites every reference to an image so it points at where the image went. The crop suffix is kept and the extension comes from the destination, because a move can also swap a PNG for a JPEG.

### [`media-session.ts`](../../lib/admin/media-session.ts)

- `resolveSession` _function_: The running session, or null when there is none. Throws when GitHub could not be asked.
- `sessionFiles` _function_: The files a session changes against its base: the PR's file list, or a compare with the base for a session branch that never got its PR.
- `readSessionJson` _function_: A JSON file as it stands on the session branch, or null when it cannot be read.
- `sessionChanges` _function_: The `- ` lines of a session PR body, one per change in the order they landed: the body is the session's log, which the admin shows before the next save.
- `SESSION_PREFIX` _const_: Which pull request a media save lands in. A session is the branch with the `media/session-` prefix and its pull request, resolved on the server so a reload, a second tab or another machine all land in the same PR.
- Types: `MediaSession`

### [`media-unique-roles.ts`](../../lib/admin/media-unique-roles.ts)

Unique roles move; they are never shared. `ride-card` and `park-background` name THE photo of a ride or a park, and `getRideImage` takes the first holder, so a second one would hide the photo just chosen.

- `uniqueClaims` _function_: Every uniqueness key an image claims, e.g. `ride-card:europa-park/voltron`.
- `rolesToYield` _function_: The roles `other` has to give up so that `claims` stay unique. A role is one flag per image, so a card that answers for two rides through `alsoRides` loses `ride-card` for both.
- `idOfSidecarPath` _function_: `public/media/europa-park/voltron.json` → `europa-park/voltron`.
- `handOverUniqueRoles` _function_: Takes every unique role the `claimants` claim from every other holder of it. `read` must answer with the file as it stands on the session branch: rebuilding it from the manifest would undo an earlier edit in the same session.
- `UNIQUE_ROLES` _const_: The roles only one image may hold per park (`park-background`) or per ride (`ride-card`).
- Types: `UniqueRole`, `RoleHolder`, `Handover`

### [`ml-overview-fixture.ts`](../../lib/admin/ml-overview-fixture.ts)

- `FIXTURE_OVERVIEW` _const_: The sample overview the ML page shows with `?beispiel=1`: the decisions and the operating data of the approved mockup, as production stood on 2026-10-11 at 20:20 UTC. The matrix counters are that day's `/admin/ml/vergleich` summary.

### [`ml-overview.ts`](../../lib/admin/ml-overview.ts)

- `decisionStateMeta` _function_: The pill for a decision state; a state this build does not know reads neutral.
- `componentStatusMeta` _function_: The dot and word for a component status, and its place in the table: failures first, then late runs, then anything nobody can vouch for. An unknown status counts as unknown.
- `componentRoleLabel` _function_: Whether the app shows what a component delivers, in two or three words; null for a new role.
- `sortComponentsProblemsFirst` _function_: The components with problems on top, otherwise in the backend's order.
- `sortDecisionsReadyFirst` _function_: The decisions ready to take on top, otherwise in the backend's order.
- `progressPercent` _function_: How full the live-measurement bar is, 0 to 100. The switch rule needs both the days and the parks, so the bar follows whichever is further from done.
- `progressDaysLabel` _function_: "live gemessen: 1 von 14 Tagen".
- `progressParksLabel` _function_: "in 3 von 10 Parks".
- `noProgressLabel` _function_: What stands where the bar would be when a decision has no live measurement.
- `formatLastRun` _function_: A last run as "11.10. 20:16" in UTC, the clock the backend states every cadence in ("täglich 06:00"), so the two columns can be compared; no park's zone, since a model runs for all of them.
- `driftStatusMeta` _function_: The dot and word for a drift status; a status this build does not know reads like no data.
- `reportCellTone` _function_: The chip tone for a report cell's matrix state (`better`, `worse`, …); muted for anything else. A `not_better` cell backs switching the model off, so there a win is the loss.
- `formatCoverageChange` _function_: A band coverage pair as `57 % → 95 %`; just the raw share while the band is served raw.
- `formatSigned` _function_: A report figure with its sign, `−0,42`, `—` when missing. The report does not carry the question's unit, so the figure goes out bare rather than with a guessed one.
- `formatInterval` _function_: An interval as `−0,80 bis −0,10`, `—` when either end is missing.
- `formatShare` _function_: A share 0 to 1 as a whole percentage, `18 %`; `—` when missing.

### [`model-comparison-fixture.ts`](../../lib/admin/model-comparison-fixture.ts)

- `fixtureDay` _function_: One replayed day as `GET /api/admin/model-comparison/day` would send it. Only the morning origin was archived for the sample, so every other origin comes back without series.
- `FIXTURE_REPORT` _const_: The matrix as `GET /api/admin/model-comparison` would send it.
- `FIXTURE_DAY_OPTIONS` _const_: The selectors as `GET /api/admin/model-comparison/day/options` would send them.

### [`model-comparison.ts`](../../lib/admin/model-comparison.ts)

- `matrixColumns` _function_: The matrix columns: the report's models in its order, then any model a cell names that the report forgot to list, labelled with its id so a new backend model still shows up.
- `groupQuestions` _function_: The questions under each group, in the report's group order; a group with none is left out.
- `measuredDays` _function_: Calendar days from the first to the last live day, both included; 0 when nothing was measured.
- `formatDiff` _function_: A difference with its sign, in German: `−0,42 min`, `+2,6 pp`. A rate arrives in percentage points (share of wrongly ordered day pairs), never as a fraction, so it gets one decimal.
- `formatError` _function_: A cell's own error, without sign: `12,4` minutes, or `31,2 %` of day pairs for a rate.
- `formatFigure` _function_: A plain figure in German with `digits` decimals: `12,4`.
- `diffFavoursModel` _function_: Whether a difference favours the model, given which direction of the metric is good.
- `whiskerGeometry` _function_: Horizontal positions, in a box `width` wide, for a difference and its interval drawn around a centred zero. The scale is symmetric so the zero line never moves between cells.
- `splitSegments` _function_: Runs of consecutive non-null values as `[index, value]` pairs, so a line can break where the ride was down instead of bridging the outage.
- `hourTickIndexes` _function_: Indexes of the slots that fall on a full hour, for the time axis.
- `hourTicks` _function_: The hour labels that fit a plot `plotWidth` px wide: every hour if they fit, else every 2nd, 3rd, … hour of the clock, the smallest step whose neighbours stay `minSpacing` apart.
- `chartTop` _function_: The y-axis top: the largest value rounded up to a multiple of 20, at least 60.
- `modelColors` _function_: One colour per model id for the given ids, stable for known models and distinct for the rest.
- `dayMae` _function_: Mean absolute error of a series against the measured waits, over the slots where both exist. Null when no slot has both.
- `truthCoverage` _function_: Share of slots with a measured wait. The backend's `truthCoverage` wins; an older response without it is counted here.
- `suggestedOptionsDate` _function_: The date the options must be fetched for before anything is picked: the suggested day when the backend suggests one other than the day it answered for, else none (the answer stands).
- `resolveDaySelection` _function_: The day, park and ride the view shows. A pick that is still on offer stands; with nothing picked the backend's suggestion is used; otherwise the first park and its first ride.
- `headlinersFirst` _function_: A park's rides with headliners first, otherwise in the order the backend sent them.
- `CELL_STATE_META` _const_: How each matrix state reads: the label in the legend and detail panel, the symbol in the circle.
- `CHECK_STATE_META` _const_: How each check state reads beside O, L and S.
- `HOUR_LABEL_MIN_SPACING` _const_: Centre-to-centre distance two hour labels need, in px: `00:00` in 11 px mono is about 34 px wide, and the rest keeps neighbours from reading as one string.
- `LOW_TRUTH_COVERAGE` _const_: Below this coverage the day view says the comparison rests on few measurements.
- Types: `DayChoice`

### [`provenance.ts`](../../lib/admin/provenance.ts)

- `provenanceBody` _function_: The optional provenance of an admin write, ready for the request body: empty fields are left out, and a value the backend would answer with a 400 is reported before the request instead.
- `REASON_MAX_LENGTH` _const_: The backend takes `reason` up to 2,000 characters and `sourceUrl` as an http(s) URL.

### [`proxy-path.ts`](../../lib/admin/proxy-path.ts)

The path guard for `/api/admin/[...path]`, pure so it can be tested without Next.

- `isSafeSegment` _function_: Returns false for an empty, `.` or `..` segment, or one holding a decoded `/`, `\`, `?` or `#` that could move the upstream admin URL.
- `adminProxyPath` _function_: `['content', 'parks', '<id>'] → 'content/parks/<id>'`, or null if unsafe.

### [`roles.ts`](../../lib/admin/roles.ts)

- `roleAtLeast` _function_: Returns true when an admin role ranks at or above the given minimum (owner &gt; editor &gt; author &gt; viewer).
- `adminGuardRefusal` _function_: Why an identity may not use a route that needs `minRole`, as the status and message to answer with, or `null` when it may. Kept apart from `requireAdmin` so `pnpm test:guards` can pin it without a backend.
- `ROLE_LABELS` _const_: What each role is called on screen.
- Types: `AdminRole`, `AdminIdentity`

### [`session.ts`](../../lib/admin/session.ts)

- `readSessionToken` _function_: The raw token from the request's cookie, or null. See `readCookie`.
- `resolveAdminIdentity` _function_: Who this request is, according to the backend.
- `forgetSession` _function_: Drop a token from the validation cache — called on logout.
- `forgetAllSessions` _function_: Drops every cached identity, for revocations that do not name a token this process can see (a password change, sign out everywhere, a deactivated account).
- `requireAdmin` _function_: Guard for this app's own admin route handlers: a ready-to-return response on failure, the identity on success. `minRole` defaults to `author` because every route behind it writes.
- `sessionCookieOptions` _function_: The `Set-Cookie` attributes a session cookie is written with.
- `denyUnlessAdmin` _function_: The one-line form of `requireAdmin`, for handlers that need no identity.
- `ADMIN_SESSION_COOKIE` _const_: The admin session cookie: httpOnly, so no script on the admin origin can read the token, and `SameSite=Strict`.
- `SESSION_ABSOLUTE_TTL_SECONDS` _const_: The backend's absolute session ceiling (`ABSOLUTE_TTL_SECONDS`), for the one case where a cookie has to be written without an `expiresAt` to derive it from.
- Types: `AdminGuardFailure`, `AdminGuardSuccess`

### [`site-analytics.ts`](../../lib/admin/site-analytics.ts)

- `parseTrafficDays` _function_: The window a `days` query value names; anything else falls back to 30 days.
- `parseTrafficLocale` _function_: The language a `locale` query value names, `null` for all of them or for junk.
- `isFilterDimension` _function_: Whether a string names a dimension a filter may use.
- `parseTrafficFilter` _function_: The filter a `dimension:value` string names, split at the first colon; `null` for junk.
- `parseTrafficFilters` _function_: The filters of an address, from its repeated `filter` parameters, one per dimension at most.
- `serializeTrafficFilters` _function_: The `dimension:value` strings of a list of filters, the way the address and the API take them.
- `toggleTrafficFilter` _function_: The filters with one more: a dimension is held to one value, so a second value of the same dimension replaces the first (two values of one dimension would match nothing), and the same value again takes it off, which makes a row in a panel …
- `withoutTrafficFilter` _function_: The filters without the one on `dim`.
- `trafficQuery` _function_: The query string both ends read: `days=30&locale=de&filter=channel:search`. `extra` is appended as given, one parameter per key.
- `deltaOf` _function_: The change from `previous` to `current`: flat under half a percent, `new` out of nothing.
- `figureDelta` _function_: The change of a figure that may be missing: `null` when either side is, as visitors are under a filter, so a percentage is never worked out from nothing.
- `hasTraffic` _function_: Whether a window holds any traffic at all, so an empty one can say so instead of drawing zeros.
- `formatCount` _function_: A count with the German thousands separator.
- `formatDecimal` _function_: A float with one decimal, `2,4`.
- `formatShare` _function_: A 0..1 share as a percentage: `42 %`, `4,2 %` under ten, `< 0,1 %` for a trace, `–` for none.
- `isHourlyPoint` _function_: Whether a series point is an hour (an ISO timestamp) and not a day.
- `formatAxisDay` _function_: A point of a series for an axis: a day as `28.10.`, an hour as `14:00`.
- `formatLongDay` _function_: A point of a series for a tooltip: `Mi 28.10.2026`, or for an hour `28.10. 14:00 UTC`.
- `sum` _function_: The sum of a list of numbers.
- `pageTypeLabel` _function_: A page type as it reads in a list; one this build has no word for stays as sent.
- `surfaceLabel` _function_: A search field as it reads in a list; one the site sends later stays as sent.
- `resultKindLabel` _function_: A result kind as it reads in a list; one the site sends later stays as sent.
- `browseItemLabel` _function_: A suggestion kind as it reads in a list; one the site sends later stays as sent.
- `countryName` _function_: A country code as its German name; `zz`, the API's "not found", reads `Unbekannt`.
- `breakdownValueLabel` _function_: How a value of a breakdown dimension reads in a list; a value this build has no word for stays as is.
- `eventInfo` _function_: The info of an event this build knows, `undefined` for any other.
- `eventLabel` _function_: The label of an event, or its bare name for one this build does not know.
- `isSearchEvent` _function_: Whether an event belongs to the search dashboard.
- `propLabel` _function_: The name of an event property in German; an unknown one stays as sent.
- `propValueLabel` _function_: How a property's value reads: search fields, result kinds and suggestions get their words.
- `sortPropValues` _function_: The values of one property in the order they read best: positions first to last and depths shallow to deep, everything else as the API sent them, which is biggest first.
- `isResolvedEntity` _function_: Whether an entity still resolves; a retired or deleted one is only an id and a count.
- `entityPublicHref` _function_: Where to read about an entity on the public site, in German, which is the admin's language.
- `entityEditorHref` _function_: Where an entity is edited: a park and a ride by id, a show or a restaurant through its park's address, which `/admin/go` resolves to the park that holds it.
- `mostCommonLabel` _function_: "der häufigste" or "die 5 häufigsten", for a hint over a list cut at its biggest entries.
- `referrerHref` _function_: The address a referrer row links to. A referrer is the external host of the first page, or the `utm_source` of the link (`newsletter`, `ig-story`), which is a label and not a site: only a value that looks like a host gets a link.
- `pathEditorHref` _function_: The editor a public path belongs to, for a path that is a park or a ride; `null` for the rest.
- `crosstabLabel` _function_: The title of a crosstab dimension: a fixed one by its word, `prop:<key>` by the property's.
- `crosstabDimensions` _function_: The dimensions an event can be crossed by: each property key it was sent with, then the fixed ones.
- `defaultCrosstab` _function_: The pair the crosstab opens on: the first property against the page type, the page type against the window width for an event without properties.
- `crosstabValueLabel` _function_: How a value of a crosstab dimension reads; `other` is the cap's remainder.
- `countMatrix` _function_: Pivots `{row, column, value}` cells into a matrix over the given rows and columns, rows without any count dropped so a page type nobody searched from does not take a line.
- `crosstabMatrix` _function_: The crosstab answer as a matrix in the order the API sent its rows and columns.
- `withoutEmptyColumns` _function_: The matrix without the columns nobody counted in, for a table with little room.
- `orderKeys` _function_: The keys of a list: the known ones that turned up first in their own order (all of them with `keepAllKnown`, for a short fixed list such as the window widths), then any other that turned up, biggest first, so a value the site sends …
- `surfaceRows` _function_: The surfaces ranked by openings, ties in the order of `SEARCH_SURFACES`.
- `surfaceOrder` _function_: The search fields of an answer in the order every chart and matrix keeps.
- `heroOrHeader` _function_: Compares the two fields the owner asked about.
- `surfacePageTypeMatrix` _function_: Page type by search field: where each field is opened. Rows are the page types found.
- `resultTypeMatrix` _function_: Result kind by search field: where which kind of result is opened.
- `browseItemMatrix` _function_: Suggestion kind by search field: what is picked from the list shown before anything is typed.
- `surfaceViewportMatrix` _function_: Search field by viewport class: how many openings came from a phone, a tablet and a computer.
- `positionRows` _function_: Click positions in order, a bucket nobody clicked kept at 0 so the shape of the list shows.
- `surfaceSeries` _function_: The daily openings of each field as one value list per field, over the days given.
- `seriesDays` _function_: The distinct days of a series, in order.
- `formatChange` _function_: The change in visits as a signed figure: `+12`, `−8`, `±0`.
- `TRAFFIC_RANGES` _const_: A window the dashboards offer, in UTC days with today included.
- `DEFAULT_TRAFFIC_DAYS` _const_: The window shown when the URL names none.
- `TRAFFIC_LOCALES` _const_: German first, then the rest: most of the traffic, and the admin's own language.
- `FILTER_DIMENSIONS` _const_: The dimensions a traffic filter can name, the API's `filter=<dimension>:<value>`.
- `DIMENSION_LABEL` _const_: What a dimension is called in a filter chip.
- `PAGE_TYPE_LABEL` _const_: The German name of a page type this build knows; see `pageTypeLabel` for any other.
- `PAGE_TYPES` _const_: The page types this build knows, in the order a matrix lists them.
- `VIEWPORTS` _const_: The window width classes, narrowest first.
- `VIEWPORT_LABEL` _const_: The German name of a window width class; the pixel limits are in the hint of the panel.
- `SURFACE_LABEL` _const_: The German name of every search field the site sends. Typed by the facade's union, so a field added there fails the build here until it has its word.
- `SEARCH_SURFACES` _const_: The search fields this build knows, the two the question is about first.
- `RESULT_KIND_LABEL` _const_: What a result opened from a search was.
- `RESULT_KINDS` _const_: The result kinds this build knows, in the order a list shows them.
- `BROWSE_ITEM_LABEL` _const_: What was picked from the list a search field shows before anything is typed.
- `BROWSE_ITEMS` _const_: The suggestion kinds this build knows, in the order a list shows them.
- `SEARCH_POSITIONS` _const_: The result positions, first to last.
- `CHANNEL_LABEL` _const_: How visits reached the site, by the API's channel names.
- `BREAKDOWN_PANELS` _const_: The title and the one-line question of each breakdown panel.
- `VISIT_DIMENSIONS` _const_: The dimensions whose rows are visits that started, and so have a bounce rate.
- `EVENT_INFO` _const_: The events this site sends, in German, with the moment each fires. The type makes a new event in `SiteEventMap` fail the build here until it has a line; an event outside the map reads as its name with no sentence, since the API takes any.
- `CROSSTAB_FIXED` _const_: The dimensions every event can be crossed by, besides its own properties.
- `SEO_CHANNELS` _const_: The channels the SEO page asks for.
- Types: `TrafficDays`, `FilterDimension`, `TrafficFilter`, `TrafficQueryState`, `TrafficDelta`, `EventInfo`, `ResolvedEntity`, `CountMatrix`, `SurfaceRow`, `HeroOrHeader`, `SeoChannel`

### [`world-map.ts`](../../lib/admin/world-map.ts)

- `countryShadePercent` _function_: How strongly a country is shaded, as the percentage of the brand colour in its fill: 0 for none, then 18 to 90 by its share of the biggest raised to `exponent`.
- `largestRing` _function_: The largest outline of an SVG path (`M`, `L`, `H`, `V`, `Z` in both cases, which is all `public/world.svg` uses), so a marker for the United States lands on the mainland and not between it and Alaska. `null` for a path without points.
- Types: `PathRing`
